assessments.reasoning: The document is served by the official WG14 document archive and each page identifies N3220 as a working draft. The editorial cover identifies the post-C23 C2y context. Fresh capture digest bccd974cd9d0227c282c9557e12e29c90df115b403ea4269f58d69661acfc113 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is N3220 §6.2.4, Storage durations of objects, paragraph 4, printed pages 37–38 / PDF pages 50–51. WG14 working draft N3220 gives an object declared with thread_local thread storage duration and associates a distinct object with each thread. The rule concerns an object whose identifier was declared using the specified storage-class specifier. This records the rule in the working draft. It does not generalize a result when an object is accessed indirectly from another thread or assert behavior in the published standard. The continuation of the paragraph makes indirect access from a different associated thread implementation-defined.
